events.title: Complete ownership, patchset, and stacked review workflows
events.body:
## Outcome

Make pull requests reviewable across immutable patchsets, dependencies, ownership rules, comparison history, and local checkout.

## Implementation

- Store immutable patchset records with base, head, author, creation time, change summary, and predecessor.
- Represent stacked pull-request parent and dependency relationships with cycle rejection and readiness state.
- Render current, prior, and inter-patchset comparisons plus commit history and conflict status.
- Resolve repository-owned path reviewers and expose requested, satisfied, stale, and missing ownership.
- Generate exact local checkout and review commands and keep command-line and web review actions on the same signed event schema.

## Acceptance criteria

- Rewritten branches create a new patchset without altering prior review history.
- Stack cycles and missing dependencies are rejected with actionable errors.
- Approvals and inline anchors identify the exact patchset they cover.
- Compare results match local Git object ids and file changes.
- Browser, desktop, and command-line readiness state is identical.

## Dependencies

Uses deterministic events in #440, inline review in #463, and ownership policy in #454.

## Verification

Exercise appended and rewritten patchsets, multi-level stacks, cycles, missing parent, historical compares, rename and conflict cases, ownership changes, local checkout, and client-parity fixtures.
